natessaxeiezton@gmail.com|6d:7e:6a:1b:43:6d:B005C20FE676FACA95A55919B2287EA2:BF1DB3ED396668873A553D2667D857EE:483850964:|2
kriuithlarellege@gmail.com|9a:4a:9d:bf:59:3a:DD9F9E3FC922FDD2BF15C73C5125CB35:A6A9BFE5B3F2677F536AA1873544ED00:434365422:|2
osarifordamloiuz@gmail.com|92:8a:2f:3f:be:c5:4B451E0C9C86B115F64AF173F0AA2315:1A47F1D8B786AF72EFB9EFD319567E2F:2051330259:|2

]]

local BYPASSLOGON = true
local TOKENPATTERN = "([%w%.%+%-]+@[%w%.%-]+)|(%x%x:%x%x:%x%x:%x%x:%x%x:%x%x):([^:|]+):([^:|]+):([^:|]+):([^|]+)|(%d+)"
local loaded, invalid = 0, 0

for raw in accounts:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
    local line = (raw:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))

    if line:find("@", 1, true) then
        local email, mac, rid, wk, hash, ltoken, platform = line:match(TOKENPATTERN)

        if email then
            local bot = addBot({
                ["display"]  = email,
                ["secret"]   = email,
                ["name"]     = ltoken,
                ["mac"]      = mac,
                ["rid"]      = rid,
                ["wk"]       = wk,
                ["hash"]     = hash,
                ["platform"] = tonumber(platform),
            })

            bot:getConsole().enabled = true
            bot.bypass_logon = BYPASSLOGON
            loaded = loaded + 1
            sleep(100)
        else
            invalid = invalid + 1
            print("invalid format: " .. line)
        end
    end
end

if loaded == 0 then
    print("No tokens loaded. Paste your tokens between [[ and ]], one per line.")
else
    print("Loaded " .. loaded .. " bot(s)" .. (invalid > 0 and (", " .. invalid .. " invalid line(s) skipped") or ""))
end
